data.name: Jaladhi
data.long_meaning: Jaladhi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jalada' which means 'carrying water' or 'oceanic'. This name is believed to have been given to those who live near water sources or are involved in water-related professions. In Hindu mythology, Jaladhi is also an epithet of Lord Vishnu, signifying his role as the preserver of water.
